item.title: Sharp rise reported in local house prices
item.description: House prices across the Shannonside region have seen a sharp rise in the last three months of this year. That's according to the Irish Independent REA Average House Price Index. The report focuses on the average price of a three-bed semi-detached home. Advertisement Prices in Longford have risen by 3.3 per cent to €221,000. item.title: Information sought on disappearance of Columba McVeigh
item.description: A local Senator is calling for anybody with information about the disappearance for Colomba McVeigh to come forward. Senator Robbie Gallagher is reminding the public, that any information brought forward by the public is legally privileged. Earlier this month, the most recent search for the remains of Columba McVeigh, one of the "disappeared" on Bragan Bog Co Monaghan ended without success. item.title: Samaritans urge those in need to reach out
item.description: Volunteers in Samaritans are ready to support those struggling to cope over the festive season. A new hub operated by Samaritans officially opened in recent weeks in Monaghan Town. The newly trained volunteers in Monaghan are answering calls to Samaritans' national freephone helpline, 116 123, which is open 24/7 including Christmas Day.
